AdjustmentCondition.description:
An adjustment condition, used by adjustment rules and adjustment plan rules.

A rule's condition may be omitted or null, which will match unconditionally.

Otherwise the **"type"** field is required and controls which other fields are required.
The following types are supported in billing adjustment rules:

Type **"dimension_equals"** evaluates whether the specified **"dimension"** contains exactly the specified **"value"**.

```
{"type":"dimension_equals", "dimension":"ProviderName", "value":"AWS"}
```

Type **"dimension_contains"** evaluates whether the specified **"dimension"** contains the specified **"value"**
anywhere within it. The match is a case-sensitive literal substring match — **"value"** is matched exactly as
given.

```
{"type":"dimension_contains", "dimension":"ProviderName", "value":"AW"}
```

Both **"dimension_equals"** and **"dimension_contains"** accept the same **"dimension"** values and are subject
to the same per-rule-type restrictions described below.

For rule types _azureReservationReallocation_, _azureSavingsPlanReallocation_, _hideCredits_, _removeAzureLicenseCosts_, _removeTax_, _reservationReallocation_, _savingsPlanReallocation_, _uncompressPricingTiers_, and _volumeDiscounts_, **"dimension"** may only be **"bill_source"**.
For rule type _supportCharge_, **"dimension"** may be **"bill_source"**, **"SubAccountId"**, or **"SubAccountName"**.
For rule types _creditMemo_ and _fixedAmount_, **"dimension"** may be **"SubAccountId"** or **"SubAccountName"**.
For other rule types, **"dimension"** may be any of most [FOCUS columns](https://focus.finops.org/focus-columns),
[Rule-Based Dimensions](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Administration/CreatingRule-BasedDimensions.htm)
defined within your organization (names starting with **rbd\_**),
[Tag Dimensions](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Administration/TagDimensions.htm)
defined within your organization (names starting with **tag\_**),
or a few dimensions Flexera populates for you.

An empty **"value"** for **"dimension_equals"** matches dimensions with either a null or an empty string value.
**"dimension_contains"** requires a non-empty **"value"**.

Types **"and"** and **"or"** evaluate whether all or any of the conditions specified in the array **"expressions"** are true.
Type **"not"** evaluates to the opposite of the single condition specified in **"expression"**.

```
{"type":"and", "expressions":[{...}]}
```
```
{"type":"or", "expressions":[{...}]}
```
```
{"type":"not", "expression":{...}}
```

Together types **"and"**, **"or"**, and **"not"** enable complex combinations of other conditions.

Configure an internally-defined unit price to rewrite select Billed Cost and Effective Cost line items.

Conditions for customUsageRate rules often examine several of the following dimensions:
- **ChargeCategory** or **PricingCategory** to differentiate between usage or discounted pricing
- **ServiceName** or **ServiceCategory** to apply to a service or category
- **SKUId** to differentiate by vendor's SKU
- **CommitmentDiscountId** to apply to selected reservations
- **ResourceId** or **ResourceType** to apply to a resource or set of resources

Tiers allow setting multiple rates by cost bracket.
The total cost captured by the rule's condition is broken up against the bounds of the tiers to calculate marginal usage within each tier.
Each tier's rate is applied to its portion of the usage, and the total replaces the original cost.

If multiple customUsageRate rules apply to the same usage record, the rules are evaluated in succession and may override preceding rules.

parameters.description:
Optional filter for returning plans matching specific criteria.

Filter parameters may be combined with 'and' and 'or' logical operators.

Each parameter may compare one of the following attributes to a given value or null.

### Plan Filter Attributes
- id, the unique identifier of a plan
- name, the name of the plan
- ruleIds, the list of unique identifiers of included rules
- customerIds, the list of unique identifiers of child organizations

### Plan Filter Comparisons
- eq, attribute matches the value, e.g. planId eq 'c6671c74-513a-4127-b8df-81adfb65bf7f'
- in, attribute is one of the values, e.g. scheduled in ['before', 'after']
- co, attribute contains the value, e.g. name co 'tier'; customerIds co 1234
- lt (le), attribute is less than (or equal to) the value, e.g. endAfter le '2025-12-31'
- gt (ge), attribute is greater than (or equal to) the value, e.g. startOn ge '2024-01-01'

- billMonth, the bill month (YYYYMM) the assignment applies to
- action, the assignment action: reassign, show, or hide
- name, the name of the credit assignment
- provider, the cloud provider
- targetBillingAccountId, the target billing account identifier
- targetBillingAccountName, the target billing account name
- targetSubAccountId, the target sub-account identifier
- targetSubAccountName, the target sub-account name
- targetCustomerId, the target customer identifier
- credits.description, the charge description of a credit row
- credits.creditType, the CCO line item type of a credit row
- credits.billingAccountId, the source billing account identifier
- credits.billingAccountName, the source billing account name
- credits.subAccountId, the source sub-account identifier
- credits.subAccountName, the source sub-account name
- credits.customerId, the source customer identifier

- eq, attribute matches the value, e.g. billMonth eq '202601'
- in, attribute is one of the values, e.g. action in ['reassign', 'hide']
- co, attribute contains the value, e.g. credits.description co 'EDP'

Creates one invoice schedule covering every customer in the request. Validation applies to the whole request: if any customer is invalid the entire request fails and nothing is created.

The schedule's invoice template is selected one of three ways:

- link an existing template: isCreateTemplate=false with invoiceTemplateId set
- create one: isCreateTemplate=true with template set, and the created template's id is returned as the schedule's invoiceTemplateId
- no template: isCreateTemplate=false with neither field, and the created schedule has no invoiceTemplateId

Any other combination is rejected with 422.

post.description:
Creates invoice exports for one or more customers.

The invoice configuration can be supplied in one of four ways:

- direct fields: provide exportType, periodType, costMetric, and displayLogoWithinPdf without a template source
- existing template: provide invoiceTemplateId; omitted root configuration fields use the saved template's values
- create saved template: provide isCreateTemplate=true and template with templateName; the new template is used and its ID is returned
- one-time template: provide template without templateName and with isCreateTemplate=false (or omitted); it supplies omitted root configuration fields but is not saved

Root configuration fields always override their corresponding template value when present. template cannot be combined with invoiceTemplateId. The four root configuration fields (exportType, periodType, costMetric, displayLogoWithinPdf) are required only when neither invoiceTemplateId nor template is supplied.

The FinOps Billing Audit API returns per-rule impact aggregations sourced from the bill audit dataset.

Audits are computed at the month grain only. The meaning of "month" is controlled by the request's periodType (chargePeriod or billPeriod). Access is controlled at the organization level; callers granted the audit query privilege see all data within the organization.

tags.name: Billing Credits

tags.description:
The Billing APIs allow you to define and edit rules that alter how your cloud bills are interpreted. Among other use cases, this supports reselling cloud services to external customers or charging back services to internal teams.

This API offers ways to manage adjustment rules, which define operations that reinterpret cloud bills. Rules are organized into four main collections:

- Enterprise Adjustment Rules: a set of rules that apply within your organization.
- Adjustment Pre-Plan Rules: rules that typically apply to a single child organization.
- Adjustment Plans: each plan is a set of rules that apply to selected child organizations.
- Adjustment Post-Plan Rules: rules that typically apply to a single child organization.

Depending on your license, you may have access to Enterprise Adjustment Rules or to the other three collections.

See
[Billing](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Optima/TODO.htm)
for more details.

This API also exposes Invoices, Invoice Templates, Invoice Schedules, and
Invoice Schedule Invoices — the same resources already available through the
finops-customizations API — so customers on the finops-billing gateway can
manage invoice generation without needing to call a second API.
tags.name: Billing

tags.description: Provides read access to invoices generated by a specific invoice schedule for an organization. This is the same resource as finops/customizations' Invoice Schedule Invoices service, exposed here under finops-billing.
tags.name: Invoice Schedule Invoices

tags.description: Invoice Schedules generate branded PDF or CSV invoices for a set of customers on a recurring monthly cadence and email them to each customer's own recipients. This is the same resource as finops/customizations' Invoice Schedules service, exposed here under finops-billing. Each run invoices the preceding billing month. A schedule is a single record covering one or more customers. Schedules are organization-scoped. Updates and deletes support optimistic concurrency through ETag / If-Match, so a stale write is rejected with 412 Precondition Failed.
tags.name: Invoice Schedules

tags.description: Invoice Templates manage reusable invoice rendering and export settings for an organization. This is the same resource as finops/customizations' Invoice Templates service, exposed here under finops-billing; it reuses the existing invoice IAM privilege family and supports optimistic concurrency via ETag / If-Match.
tags.name: Invoice Templates

tags.description:
Shared cost rules let you redistribute a set of costs across multiple destinations
based on configurable allocation strategies such as equal splits, fixed-percentage splits, or
usage-based proportional splits.
Rules are evaluated in priority order (lowest priority number first). Each rule identifies
source costs via dimensions (FOCUS dimensions, custom dimensions) and
distributes them to one or more destination dimension values.
Processing unit: allocations are applied in isolation per bill connect and per bill month.
Rules do not allocate costs across different bill connects or across different bill months.
tags.name: Shared Cost Rules
